decision.reason: The cited excerpt [ev-17bb38a28de1] is only a table-of-contents entry. The section context [ev-0c1262a1a2a5] adds that external secret stores were an unmaintained alpha feature and that users should move to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading. That confirms the removal and gives the replacement, but it does not name what marks an environment as exposed (no feature flag, resource kind or spec field). It also does not say what happens to an environment that does nothing, such as failing to write secrets, rejecting resources or failing the upgrade. The detailed upgrade-guide section or the linked pull request would be needed to write the applicability condition and the consequence.
